paths: operator calls through the guarded account

mustContinue: the principal's own direct access to the account
inFlight: nothing is in flight during maintenance; any late call is refused

duration.condition: until maintenance of the assistant's runtime image is complete

resume.condition: new runtime image attested and pinned dependencies updated in a new binding or confirmed unchanged

metadata.note: Full stop dominates: the de-risking allow list of the guarded account does not apply while bit 16 is set.
